lines.text: Editor: exports and the 100 % view lose the purple and green fringes near the frame's edges. Export again to fix one.
Smaller exports are sharper, with much less moiré, and the Library's tiles load many times faster.
The dial stays smooth when zoomed in and stays exactly where your finger leaves it.
Auto level gives the same angle every press, before and after show your crop, and black is truly black.
